gate4.rationale: The variant did not beat the current accepted independent-source consensus comparator across all three windows.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: theme-density participation may add an independent confirmation family to accepted free-data consensus.

2_history_check.exp-20260526-016: Standalone theme-density paper sleeve rejected after late_strong/old_thin regressions.
2_history_check.exp-20260604-002: Broad-market source-family addition had zero selected overlap.
2_history_check.exp-20260604-005: Form4 source-family addition had zero selected overlap.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; accept only if the variant beats core and current accepted consensus in all windows.

prediction.confidence_reason: Meta research favors default-off paper adapters; standalone theme-density failed, but using it only as confirmation could improve accepted consensus without adding raw ticker noise.

preflight.alpha_hypothesis: Theme-density confirmed breakout rows may improve the accepted independent free-data consensus when used only as a new production-visible confirmation family, not as standalone noisy ticker expansion.
preflight.playbook_alignment: Meta research ranks default-off paper adapters highest. This uses a materially different free-OHLCV theme-participation field instead of source-count, FINRA, VIX, Form4, SEC text, or post-earnings scalar retunes.
preflight.prior_difference: exp-20260526-016 tested standalone theme-density paper trades and failed. This run does not trade raw theme-density rows; it only asks whether they can confirm already accepted consensus same-date same-ticker candidates.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A retained theme-density source family would need the shared free-data consensus paper adapter to load the same production-visible theme-density rows in daily production and historical replay, plus parity tests, before any report queue, notional, candidate priority, or order surface could change.
